title: Death Certificate song
description: This resource pack changes the texture of records and their music to songs by the popular Russian post-punk band "Death Certificate"
body:
This resource pack changes the texture of records and their music to songs by the popular Russian post-punk band "**Death Certificate**"
The songs in the resource pack are divided into albums. Such as:

- **Roof Sides** (2 songs)

Not me (https://youtu.be/iSwLa-RSUx0?si=PrZgv0ybLh1OycsX)

When I answered yes (https://youtu.be/1EehbuEhf0w?si=jitV_nMcoq_sKxC2)

- **Deader Than All The Dead** (1 song)

When the sun goes out (https://youtu.be/Xqluj6XkLjA?si=-vLwJifyOYpdJGke)

- **After rotten day** (1 song)

Your Home (https://youtu.be/K62H-2IKzVg?si=jCzV6PVaGyKOCEaS)

The author does not support everything said in the songs and it is all fiction.
